entry.title: BILL061(26) (Honolulu): CCL → BUD
entry.content:
RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAXATION.

Repeals the 15-year limitation on the availability of the RPT exemption for qualifying affordable rental dwelling units or housing units. Allows the RPT exemption to instead continue for as long as the affordable housing rental project is subject to an affordable housing agreement or a declaration of restrictive covenants. Makes conforming amendments.

Status: CCL → BUD

Latest action: CR-304(26) Reported out for passage on second reading and scheduling of a public hearing as amended in CD1 form.

entry.title: Bill 192 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): Passed Second Reading → Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 19, ARTICLE 11, SECTION 19-90 OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAX

Extends the requirement to appropriate residential tier-two and tier-three property tax revenue to the housing and homelessness fund until 2029; requires that monies from the fund be used to award grants that address housing and homelessness.
